name: Smitha's Roses Dew Beauty Lounge Al Nahda
address: Hay Al Nahda - Al Qusais Industrial Area - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Roses Dew Ladies Saloon is a high-end beauty and wellness establishment located in the heart of the city. We pride ourselves on providing an exceptional and luxurious experience to our valued clientele. With a team of highly skilled and trained professionals, we offer a wide range of services including hair styling, makeup application, nail care, and spa treatments.

At Roses Dew, we understand the importance of personal care and beauty enhancement for women. Our vision is to empower and uplift women by enhancing their natural beauty and boosting their self-confidence. We believe that every woman deserves to be pampered and to feel beautiful inside and out.

reviews.author: abhirami AbhiZ
reviews.text:
I had the Nanopalstia treatment at Roses Dew Salon Al Nahda and my experience has been extremely disappointing. Just one week after the service, my hair is severely dry, damaged, and in the worst condition it has ever been. *My hair has started to curl unnaturally and feels very dry*, rough, brittle, and completely unhealthy — which is the opposite of what a Nanopalstia treatment is supposed to deliver.

I paid 750 AED for the service, expecting professional results and proper aftercare. On top of that, I purchased their recommended shampoo and conditioner at the salon, hoping it would help maintain the treatment. Instead, it made the situation worse — my hair feels even drier and more unmanageable since using those products.

The staff member who attended to me was polite and professional, so I want to acknowledge that. However, the overall quality of the service, the treatment outcome, and the products provided were far below acceptable standards.

I chose this salon because of its reputation and because I genuinely believed it would be a safe and reliable choice. Unfortunately, I cannot recommend Roses Dew Salon Al Nahda based on my experience, and I will not be returning unless there are significant improvements in their service and quality control. _Please don’t go here if you value your hair._

I hope the management reviews this feedback seriously and takes steps to address the issue.

Even after one month, my hair only started returning to its normal state on its own. The results were nowhere near what they claimed, and the entire experience left me very unhappy.

They also pressured me to buy their products like shampoo, hair mask, and even a face mask. The way they insisted was extremely uncomfortable. Honestly, it was a very terrible experience.

I will not recommend the Sharjah Al Nahda Rose’s Dew salon to anyone. And dont trust any discounts.

I went for a protein treatment and the service was a complete disaster. My scalp got burnt during the process, and the staff were very unprofessional and rude. Most of them don’t even understand English or Hindi, making communication extremely difficult.

The salon didn’t even have basic amenities like drinking water. The advertised price was AED399, but they added hidden charges and the final bill came to AED550. They also pressured me to buy their shampoos and other hair products, and when I refused, they behaved badly and made unpleasant faces.

Overall, a terrible experience untrained staff, poor customer service, and misleading pricing. I’ll never visit this place again and don’t recommend it.
